name: @smartretailx/newman-api-tests
description: Newman (Postman CLI) API tests + HTML evidence reports for SmartRetailX

scripts.test:api: mkdir -p reports && newman run smartretailx.postman_collection.json -e dev.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export ./reports/newman-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "SmartRetailX API Test Report" --reporter-htmlextra-darkTheme
